name: macabre_waltz_refuses_a_third_target_an_opponents_card_and_a_noncreature_card
notes: Printed: 'Return up to two target creature cards from your graveyard to your hand, then discard a card.' Seat 0's graveyard holds three creature cards and an instant; seat 1's holds a creature card. Three targets is more than 'up to two': refused. A creature card in the OPPONENT's graveyard is not 'from your graveyard': refused. The instant in seat 0's own graveyard is not a creature card: refused. Each refusal pays nothing (the Black mana stays in the pool, the Waltz stays in hand). One target is allowed ('up to two'): casting at Fallen One alone returns it, and the discard (Spare) is the one card seat 0 chooses; Fallen Two and Fallen Three are untouched.
